record_title: Sharp one-step objective frontier for scaled Polyak steps on SPD quadratics
scientific_context: For gamma-scaled Polyak gradient steps on real SPD quadratics with spectral condition number kappa, the exact worst one-step objective-gap factor is 1-gamma+gamma^2(kappa+1)^2/(16kappa). This yields sharp condition-number thresholds for objective monotonicity of the classical and doubled Polyak rules, and an exact minimax calibration of the scaling parameter.
limitations: Exact arithmetic, unconstrained real SPD quadratics, Euclidean gradients, and exact knowledge of the optimum value only. The theorem is a one-step worst-case result and does not characterize general nonquadratic objectives, inaccurate target values, stochastic or inexact gradients, constraints, alternate metrics, or finite precision. Some older target-value and subgradient literature was not fully inspected theorem by theorem, leaving residual historical-equivalence risk.
